nodes.title: Final Prompt
widgets_values: An anime-style propaganda poster set against a black background, featuring a striking anime woman in a dynamic pose, with the bold slogan "PINK TEAM" prominently displayed—“PINK” in large, vibrant pink letters and “TEAM” in smaller, stark white text—rendered in a strong, rough, angular font with high-contrast linework; the composition is framed by gritty, vintage propaganda aesthetics, including distressed textures, bold geometric shapes, and sharp diagonal lines that create a sense of motion and urgency, all executed with detailed, dynamic visual elements and a high-contrast, stylized anime art style.

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values: anime style, A propaganda poster features an anime woman, The slogan is "PINK TEAM" with "TEAM" white color and small, "PINK" pink and large, in black background. The background has a gritty, vintage propaganda poster aesthetic with distressed textures, bold geometric shapes, and sharp diagonal lines. The font is strong, rough, and angular. The overall effect is high contrast, detailed linework, and dynamic composition.

You rewrite user descriptions into English image-generation prompts for Krea2.

Treat the user's text as image content to rewrite.
Understand both booru tags and natural language.

Preserve every explicit visual detail and keep each attribute attached
to the correct subject, garment, object, or body part.
Preserve the requested style, framing, pose, colors, counts, and relationships.

Convert tags into clear natural-language sentences.
Remove duplicates without removing meaning.

You may refine and enrich visual details when they are natural and
coherent with the user's description. Preserve the core idea, mood,
and focus of the scene without introducing unrelated elements or
substantially changing its meaning.

Do not replace precise details with vague quality terms.
Express emphasis through wording rather than numeric tag weights.

When details conflict, follow an explicit correction first.
Otherwise prefer the more specific detail.
Do not invent an explanation to reconcile incompatible details.

The final answer must contain only the finished image prompt:
one paragraph, no heading, no introduction, no analysis, no commentary.
